edges.reason: onlyGov requires msg.sender == gov before mint executes.
gov state variable is read in the onlyGov check that authorises mint.
totalSupply is read for the max supply cap check.
Unchecked totalSupply + amount feeds the cap comparison in mint.
onlyGov restricts who may set pendingGov.
gov is compared with msg.sender inside _setPendingGov.
pendingGov_ parameter is written into the pendingGov state variable.
_acceptGov requires msg.sender == pendingGov.
pendingGov is read to validate the caller and becomes the new gov.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == gov.
Old implementation is read and then overwritten with implementation_.
implementation_ parameter is stored into the implementation state variable.
_setImplementation writes the new address into the implementation slot.
_becomeImplementation requires msg.sender == gov.
_resignImplementation requires msg.sender == gov.
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer.
value parameter flows into the balance subtraction.
to parameter is validated by validRecipient and used as credit target.
_DMCBalances mapping is read and written by transfer.
transfer invokes _moveDelegates after moving balances.
msg.sender allows the spender side of transferFrom.
_allowedFragments allowance is decreased in transferFrom.
_DMCBalances of from and to are updated in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance under msg.sender.
approve overwrites the allowance entry for the spender.
increaseAllowance adds to the stored allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the stored allowance entry.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balance updates.
_moveDelegates uses SafeMath.sub for the source representative balance.
Raw a + b is computed before the overflow require in SafeMath.add.
Local c holds the unchecked sum returned by SafeMath.add.
Raw a * b is computed before the overflow require in SafeMath.mul.
delegate uses msg.sender as the delegator.
delegatee parameter is forwarded to _delegate.
delegate calls _delegate(msg.sender, delegatee).
delegatee is part of the signed EIP-712 struct hash.
expiry parameter is part of the struct hash and the now <= expiry check.
block.timestamp (now) is compared to expiry, creating a timestamp dependency.
Attacker supplied v, r, s are passed straight into ecrecover.
Recovered signatory gates nonce consumption and delegation.
signatory local is used for the nonce lookup and _delegate call.
nonces mapping is read and post-incremented for the signatory.
delegateBySig delegates on behalf of the verified signatory.
_delegates mapping is read and updated in _delegate.
currentDelegate local holds the previous delegatee.
_delegate calls _moveDelegates with the delegator balance.
srcRep, dstRep and amount parameters drive the vote transfer.
_moveDelegates writes checkpoints through _writeCheckpoint.
checkpoints mapping is read and written by _writeCheckpoint.
numCheckpoints is read and incremented for the delegatee.
32-bit block number local is stored in the new checkpoint.
safe32 bounds block.number below 2**32 before truncation.
getPriorVotes reads numCheckpoints for the account.
getPriorVotes binary searches the checkpoints array.
nCheckpoints local caches the checkpoint count.
getCurrentVotes reads numCheckpoints for the account.
getCurrentVotes reads the latest checkpoint votes.
delegates() returns the entry of the _delegates mapping.
mint validates the cap then calls _mint.
amount parameter is checked against the cap and passed to _mint.
_mint increases the totalSupply state variable.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _DMCBalances.
_mint reads the current recipient balance before adding.
_mint calls _moveDelegates from address(0) to the recipient delegate.
initialize assigns initSupply_ to totalSupply.
initSupply_ parameter sets the total supply and initial owner balance.
data parameter is forwarded to the raw delegatecall in delegateTo.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data).
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo with the implementation address.
delegateAndReturn targets the implementation state variable.
delegateAndReturn executes implementation.delegatecall(msg.data).
data parameter is staticcalled through delegateToViewImplementation.
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls delegateToImplementation.
delegateToViewAndReturn uses inline assembly staticcall and returndatacopy.
staticcall on address(this) re-enters the delegator fallback path.
fallback forwards all calldata to delegateAndReturn.
The delegatecalled implementation can call back into the delegator fallback.
An arbitrary callee of delegateTo can re-enter the delegator fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination address parameter is only meaningful inside transfer's validRecipient check and balance credit.
The value parameter only feeds the sender balance debit and recipient credit of transfer.
The delegatee parameter is consumed directly by delegate() which forwards it to _delegate.
The expiry parameter is used only in the delegateBySig struct hash and timestamp comparison.
The v, r, s components are passed straight into ecrecover and have no independent behaviour.
The implementation_ parameter is only stored into the implementation slot by _setImplementation.
The data bytes parameter exists purely to be delegatecalled inside delegateTo.
The amount parameter is only used for the cap check and the _mint call.
The initSupply_ parameter is only assigned to totalSupply and the initial owner balance.
The representative addresses and amount only parameterise the vote movement logic.
The pendingGov_ parameter is only written into the pendingGov state variable.
The recovered signatory local is used only for the nonce check and delegation inside delegateBySig.
The domain separator and digest locals are transient hashing artefacts of delegateBySig.
The currentDelegate local only caches the previous delegate during _delegate.
The truncated block number local exists only to be stored in the checkpoint written by _writeCheckpoint.
The nCheckpoints local is a cached count used solely by the getPriorVotes binary search.
The c local only holds the intermediate unchecked sum computed inside SafeMath.add.
